scenes.say: AWS or Azure? Learn the wrong one and you waste months.
scenes.title: AWS or Azure?

scenes.say: AWS is Amazon's cloud, the first and the biggest. Azure is Microsoft's cloud, built into big companies.
AWS still leads, with about 30 percent of the cloud market. Azure is close behind at about 20.
scenes.label: AWS share of the cloud market

scenes.say: The services are twins with different names. EC2 is Virtual Machines. S3 is Blob Storage. Lambda is Functions.
Azure wins where Microsoft already lives: Office, Entra ID logins, Windows servers, and OpenAI models.
So how do you choose? Building a startup? Start with AWS. Your company runs on Microsoft? Pick Azure. Either way, the skills transfer.
scenes.title: how to choose

scenes.say: Learn one cloud deeply. The second one takes weeks, not years.
scenes.title: Learn one cloud deeply
